posts.text:
The real challenge isn't building AI agents. It's building agents people can trust.

We will be hosting the second edition of Nasiko AMA Hours with Darko Mesaroš, Distinguished Developer Advocate at Amazon Web Services (AWS).

We'll discuss AI agent guardrails, common risks in agentic systems, and practical ways to build more reliable AI agents. We'll also have a live AMA, so bring your questions.

If you're part of any AWS community, we'd love to have you join the conversation. Let's make this a great community AMA together.

📅 6th August | 10:30 PM IST
📍 Nasiko Discord Stage

Register Now 👉 https://lnkd.in/dqHEciZm

Some places define you. Some change you into a better version of yourself.

Nasiko gave me the opportunity to build, scale, learn, and advocate for Agentic AI ecosystem. But beyond the technology, DevRel has always been about people and trust.

What makes Nasiko special is its culture. A team of passionate, energetic, and genuinely supportive people who are always pushing each other to grow.
Looking forward to contributing more, learning every day, and growing alongside this incredible team.

𝑴𝒐𝒔𝒕 𝒅𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒍𝒐𝒑𝒆𝒓𝒔 𝒘𝒂𝒏𝒕 𝒕𝒐 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒓𝒊𝒃𝒖𝒕𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒐𝒑𝒆𝒏 𝒔𝒐𝒖𝒓𝒄𝒆, 𝑽𝒆𝒓𝒚 𝒇𝒆𝒘 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒉𝒐𝒘 𝒕𝒐 𝒈𝒆𝒕 𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒓𝒕𝒆𝒅.

We hosted the first edition of Nasiko AMA Hours with Alexandre Therrien, an experienced software engineer Intact and Rust contributor Rust Foundation, where we had an honest conversation about open source, Rust, GitHub, and building a long-term career through contributions.

Here are a few key takeaways:
• Your first contribution doesn't have to be code.
• Small, consistent contributions create lasting impact.
• Reading source code is one of the fastest ways to learn.
• Documentation, testing, bug reports, and reviews are just as valuable as writing code.
• Open source is about collaboration, not perfection.

It was great to see developers and open source enthusiasts come together for thoughtful discussions and practical learning. A sincere thank you to Alexandre Therrien for sharing his experience and valuable insights, and to everyone who joined us and made our first Nasiko AMA Hours a success.

We're just getting started. More AMA sessions, technical talks, workshops, and community events are on the way to help developers learn, contribute, and connect with the open source ecosystem. 

Join the Nasiko Discord community to be part of what's next.

🚨 Happening tonight! Don't miss it.

If you've been thinking about contributing to open source or getting started with Rust, join us for a live Discord AMA with Alexandre Therrien today at 10:30 PM IST.

Come with your questions, leave with practical advice. Don't forget to join us! 👇

Thanks Rajarshi Datta for your wonderful words, I am honoured to contribute to your Developer Journey. 🙃👍

Keep Growing, and looking forward to see you accomplish new milestones and achievements 🤩🤝
